blurb:
Colorado is showing off its beauty when it comes to Pikes Peak and Garden of the Gods! Located in the Rocky Mountains, West of Colorado Springs, Pikes Peak is the highest summit in the Front Range boasting sprawling views for miles. Explore the endless trails at Garden of the Gods, and disconnect as you view the gigantic sandstone formations surrounding you. Enjoy 14,115ft of beauty right in Denver’s backyard. Eat lunch in the charming town of Manitou Springs before taking on America's mountain. 

Spring-Fall, access to Pikes Peak may be limited due to weather, with turnarounds required at designated mile markers for safety. However, the views are still incredible in lower sections of the mountain as well. 

Aspire Tours specializes in dynamic and hand-crafted sightseeing adventures in the Colorado Rockies. Our local five-star guides design immersive experiences to help you create meaningful moments with people & places.
